catalog_separation.interpretation: A rupture that is kilometres from every mapped fault is either unmapped or mapped on a different strand; either way it is a candidate the published catalogue does not express.

corridor.note: all in-footprint pixels within 1.15 x the minor-axis sigma of the fitted envelope axis (minimum 3 px = 300 m, the metric's kernel support); the published catalogue is excluded by construction

caveats: Epicentres are not a rupture trace; the across-strike width is a modelling choice.
The 2020 sequence is ONE earthquake; its envelope predicts where that rupture is, not where other unmapped faults are.

Surface displacement of the 2020 event was mostly < 5 cm over zones up to 800 m wide, so it may be absent from the expert label set even though the fault is real. That is a reason for a SMALL mass, not for omitting the hypothesis.
